name: Pamela Weiss
reason: Her own site pamelaweiss.com (named on her San Francisco Zen Center page) returned 401 on /secondsunday (a password-protected members' page) on 6 Nov 2026, so under the standing rule nothing more may be taken from the site. Her contact details sit on /publications ('Contact Pamela'), which I fetched in the same loop just after the 401 (a slip) and then deleted unread; without it there is no usable email or contact form. She otherwise looks a good fit (Soto Zen and Insight teacher, author of A Bigger Sky, guiding teacher at San Francisco Insight); the owner may want to clear the site for a re-run.
